name: karaoke-read-along
title: Karaoke Read-Along
description: A paragraph that highlights each chunk in sync with a timer while an aria-live region reads the current chunk — designed for language learning and read-along accessibility, with speed control and pause.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Playback Control: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
